title: Can I use Sephora gift card online?
description: Can I use Sephora gift card online? Aug 3, 2019  Gift Cards are physical cards with a 16-digit card number and an 8-digit PIN. ... You can pay for your U.S. merchandise order with a Gift Card, eGift Card, or an eGift Certificate. Gift Cards and eGift Cards can be used online, on our mobile app, in U.S. and Canada Sephora stores, and at Sephora inside JCPenney Stores.
